# Phase 2 synthetic People/Search fixtures

These five images are entirely fictional AI-generated adult test subjects and
test scenes. They do not depict students, teachers, family members, or any
other real person. They are committed solely to make the isolated Immich
People, facial-clustering, Smart Search, ACL, and browser fixtures reproducible.

The fixture runner derives labelled crops and scene variants locally. It must
never mix these files with a real archive import, NAS library, or public
runtime.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `fictional-cast-portraits.png` | Three fictional portrait subjects A/B/C |
| `fictional-cast-playground.png` | Playground / group-scene search fixture |
| `fictional-cast-classroom.png` | Classroom / blackboard / basketball fixture |
| `fictional-cast-night-cake.png` | Evening / cake / group-scene fixture |
| `fictional-cast-outdoor.png` | Outdoor activity fixture |
